tiers.name: Easy
items: Around 350 coins
1 Silk or Vial of stench
1 Full Grown Cat OR Overgrown cat (kept after the task if you don't swap for death runes.)
1 Unicorn horn
1 Cowhide
1 Ring of duelling
A weapon will be useful as well as some Ardougne teleport runes (2 water runes and 2 law runes per cast) OR access to the Ardougne Lodestone
tiers.ironman:
The following are not required if you obtain the emerald ring or ring of duelling as a drop instead:
• 1 Gold bar
• 1 Emerald
• 1 Cosmic rune
• 3 Air runes or a staff that provides air runes

tasks.name: The Essence of Magic
tasks.desc: Have Wizard Cromperty teleport you to the essence mine.
tasks.notes: Talk to Wizard Cromperty and have him teleport the player to the Rune Essence mine.

tasks.name: Yoink!
tasks.desc: Attempt to steal from any stall in Ardougne Market, or from any guard.
tasks.notes: Attempt to steal from any stall in Ardougne market, or from any guard.

tasks.name: Silky Smooth
tasks.desc: Sell silk to the silk trader in Ardougne for 60gp each by haggling.
tasks.notes:
Sell silk to the silk merchant in Ardougne for 60 coins each.
It requires talking to the merchant and offering a price of 120 first, then responding to his counter offer with a price of 60.

tasks.name: Preaching to the Infected
tasks.desc: Use the altar in West Ardougne's church.
tasks.notes: Use the altar in West Ardougne's church.

tasks.name: Playing the Waiting Game
tasks.desc: Enter the Castle Wars waiting room.
tasks.notes: Enter the Castle Wars waiting room. Just deposit all your non-combat items in the bank chest and enter any portal. You can exit the room using the portal in the centre.

tasks.name: Gone Fishing
tasks.desc: Go out fishing on the Fishing Trawler.
tasks.notes:
Go out fishing on the Fishing Trawler.
The player does not need to complete a trip on the Trawler; the fishbowl helmet and diving apparatus are not needed; pets (such as a cat) are not allowed, including in the backpack.

tasks.name: Boot Camp
tasks.desc: Enter the Combat Training Camp north of West Ardougne.
tasks.notes: Enter the Combat Training Camp north of West Ardougne.

tasks.name: A Cat is For Life...
tasks.desc: Talk to a civilian in West Ardougne about selling a cat.
tasks.notes:
Talk to a civilian in West Ardougne about selling a cat while having a non-kitten cat in the inventory. Civilians are located in the north-western area inside West Ardougne. The cat does not need to be sold to complete this achievement.
Using a cat on the civilian will result in the cat being sold, while also completing the achievement.
Cats that can be used for this achievement are:
• Purple cats
• Hellcats
• Fully grown cats
• Overgrown cats
• Wily cats
• Lazy cats

tasks.name: Creator and Destroyer
tasks.desc: Kill a unicow in the Tower of Life.
tasks.notes:
Kill a unicow in the Tower of Life.
To make a unicow, a cowhide and a unicorn horn need to be used on the north-western altar in the basement of the Tower of Life. Players need to have finished the Tower of Life quest to get into the tower's basement.

tasks.name: Red Revolution
tasks.desc: Get a civilian to throw a tomato at the army recruiter in West Ardougne.
tasks.notes: Get a civilian to throw a tomato at the recruiter in the West Ardougne town square. The player must talk to the recruiter and go through the dialogue, which will eventually lead the civilians to throw tomatoes at him.

tasks.name: Going on a Summer Holiday
tasks.desc: Sail from East Ardougne to Karamja.
tasks.notes: Sail from East Ardougne to Karamja by talking to Captain Barnaby on the dock just east of The Poison Arrow in south-eastern East Ardougne costing 30 coins (free if the ring of charos is worn).

tasks.name: Breaking and Entering
tasks.desc: Attempt to picklock a certain door east of the gem stall in Ardougne's marketplace.
tasks.notes: Attempt to pick-lock the door east of the gem stall in Ardougne Market which is the southern house on the east side of the marketplace. Right click on the door and select "Pick-lock". The attempt does not need to be successful for the achievement to be completed.

tasks.name: P-P-P-Pick Up Some Prizes
tasks.desc: Spend some Penguin Points with Larry (or Chuck) at Ardougne Zoo.
tasks.notes: Spend some penguin points with Larry (or Chuck) at Ardougne Zoo.

tasks.name: A Gift from Khazard
tasks.desc: Use the Summoning obelisk to the east of the Fight Arena.
tasks.notes: Use the Summoning obelisk to the east of the Fight Arena. This can even be done with full Summoning points.

tasks.name: Party Pooper
tasks.desc: Pop a balloon in the monastery south of Ardougne.
tasks.notes:
Pop a balloon in the Ardougne Monastery south of Ardougne. Talk to Brother Omad to make some balloons drop.
The quest does not have to be completed in order to complete this achievement; the balloon drop can be triggered by a different player.

tasks.name: Vial Deeds
tasks.desc: Buy a water-filled vial from the general store run by Aemad and Kortan.
tasks.notes: Buy a vial of water costing 10 coins from Aemad's Adventuring Supplies which is run by Aemad and Kortan and is located south of the church and north of the Ardougne Zoo.

tasks.name: Star Seeker
tasks.desc: Use the noticeboard near the Observatory to gather information about shooting stars.
tasks.notes:
Use the Shooting Star noticeboard near the Observatory to gather information about shooting stars. The noticeboard is not in the Observatory but in the small house where the Observatory Quest is started, just north of the Observatory.
The players can also find the Shooting Star noticeboard next to Wizard Rosalina on the 2nd floor (UK) / 3rd floor (US) of the Wizards' Tower, which allows free-to-play players to do this task.

tasks.name: Dukes of Khazard
tasks.desc: Kill something on the Khazard Battlefield.
tasks.notes: Kill something on the Khazard Battlefield. The battlefield is north of the Tree Gnome Village. Killing a combatant on any side will work.

tasks.name: Don't Eat the Pointy Bit
tasks.desc: Buy a skewered kebab from the Poison Arrow pub.
tasks.notes: Buy a skewered kebab from The Poison Arrow pub which costs 25 coins. The Poison Arrow pub is located in south-east East Ardougne, just south-east of the bank.

tasks.name: Bargain Hunter
tasks.desc: View the Hunter equipment in Aleck's shop in Yanille.
tasks.notes: View the Hunter equipment in Aleck's Hunter Emporium. Aleck and his shop are located in south-west Yanille.

tasks.name: Are You Being Served?
tasks.desc: Talk to the chief servant at the servants' guild to find out about servants for your house.
tasks.notes: Talk to the Chief Servant at the Servants' Guild to find out about servants for a player-owned house. The Servants' Guild is located in the north-eastern corner of East Ardougne, just south-east of the Ardougne lodestone.

tasks.name: No Time to Lose
tasks.desc: Use a ring of duelling to teleport to Castle Wars.
other: The following are not required if an emerald ring or ring of duelling are obtained as a drop instead:

One of:
• 33 Magic Magic or
• 40 Smithing Smithing
The following is not required if a ring of duelling is obtained as a drop:
tasks.notes: Use a ring of duelling to teleport to Castle Wars by choosing the Castle Wars option on the ring. This achievement can be completed by using a stored ring of duelling within a passage of the abyss.

tasks.name: They're Long and Pointy
tasks.desc: Talk to Tindel Marchant about identifying swords on Kandarin's east coast.
tasks.notes: Talk to Tindel Marchant about identifying swords. He is located at the end of the southern most pier in eastern Port Khazard. Merely asking him about swords is enough to complete the achievement, so a rusty sword is not required.

reward.intro:
Talk to Doctor Orbon, who is located in the East Ardougne church, to claim the rewards for the easy achievement set:
Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.

Ardougne cloak 1, which grants the following bonuses:
perks: Unlimited teleports to the Ardougne Monastery
Some drops from the Creature Creation activity in the Tower of Life will be noted
Increasing the success chance of stealing from stalls in Ardougne by 10%
Unlimited use of Kandarin monastery Teleport
Prayer points are boosted by 10% upon entry to Castle Wars
Trading a cat with civilian in West Ardougne gives 200 death runes (instead of 100)
25% chance to spawn an additional chompy bird while hunting chompy birds

tiers.name: Medium
other: 49 Crafting Crafting (to complete The Hand in the Sand)
A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen (Partial)
items: 1 Raw swordfish
1 Raw chicken
2 Water runes or a Staff of water and 2 Law runes (you have to be on normal spellbook (unless you use spellbook swap) to cast ardougne teleport, tablets don't work)
1 Lunar staff or Dramen staff (unless you've completed A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift)
At least 1 pure essence

• 1 Mithril bolt
• 1 Rope

tasks.name: A Visit to Charlie
tasks.desc: Enter the unicorn pen in Ardougne Zoo using the fairy rings.
quests: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen
tasks.notes:
Enter the unicorn pen in Ardougne Zoo by using the fairy rings to travel to the fairy ring with the code BIS.
A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen only needs to be done up to the point where the player uses the fairy rings during the quest. No staff is needed if the player has completed A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift.

tasks.name: I Wonder What This Does
tasks.desc: Teleport to the Wilderness using the lever in Ardougne.
tasks.notes:
Teleport to the Wilderness using the lever in Ardougne, which is located in a building along the eastern side of the wall that separates East Ardougne from West Ardougne (marked with a transportation symbol on the map). It will take the player to the Deserted Keep in the deep Wilderness.
Players who are opted into PvP are recommended not to bring anything that one is not willing to lose. Players can quickly teleport back to Ardougne by pulling the lever right next to where the first lever takes them. However, there is no guarantee players can teleport back without being attacked or killed.

tasks.name: Sandy's Secret Getaway
tasks.desc: Grapple over Yanille's south wall.
other: The following are not required if you obtain a mithril grapple as a drop instead:
tasks.notes:
Grapple over Yanille's southern wall.
A mithril grapple and a crossbow (mithril or better) need to be wielded to complete this achievement. Alternatively, one may use an enhanced grappling hook on the tool belt. Any crossbow can be used with the mithril grapple as long as the player has the required Ranged level. Players can also use the grapple hidey-hole which they may have constructed to complete the task. The point to grapple over the southern wall is located behind the pub/bar.

tasks.name: I Know a Shortcut
tasks.desc: Craft some runes at Ourania Altar.
tasks.notes:
Craft some runes (any kind, with pure essence only) at the Ourania Runecrafting Altar.
If the player takes the long route, there is no need to have protection against the NPCs. However if the player takes the short route, a high combat level is strongly recommended.

tasks.name: Volatile Valuables
tasks.desc: Sell some rubium to Ezekial Lovecraft in Witchaven.
tasks.notes: Sell some rubium to Ezekial Lovecraft, who is the owner of the fishing shop in the town of Witchaven.

tasks.name: What, a Melon?
tasks.desc: Pick watermelons from the Farming patch north of Ardougne.
tasks.notes: Pick watermelons from the Farming patch north of East Ardougne. You need to first grow watermelons in the allotment patch in Ardougne and then return to harvest them when fully grown.

tasks.name: Ardougne Express
tasks.desc: Cast the Ardougne Teleport spell.
tasks.notes: Cast the Ardougne Teleport spell which requires 2 law runes and 2 water runes. Teleport tablets will not work.

tasks.name: Arriving in Style
tasks.desc: Travel to Castle Wars by hot-air balloon.
tasks.notes: Travel to Castle Wars by hot-air balloon. 40 charges (or ten yew logs) are required if the route has not been unlocked yet. See this page for detailed instructions on how to unlock it. Only 4 charges are required if the route is already unlocked.

tasks.name: By the Bucketload
tasks.desc: Claim buckets of sand from Bert in Yanille.
tasks.notes: Claim buckets of sand from Bert in Yanille. After completion of the quest The Hand in the Sand, players can talk to Bert to deliver 294 buckets of sand to the player's bank weekly.

tasks.name: Meeting History, Again
tasks.desc: After Meeting History, return to the past and talk to Sarah about Herblore.
tasks.notes:
Return to the past and talk to Sarah about Herblore after Meeting History.
Have nothing equipped, dismiss any followers and have only the enchanted key in the inventory. From the sheep pen gate (north of Ardougne, east side of the river) walk north to the edge of the fence and then three steps west onto a small patch of flowers. Rub (not feel) the key and go to past B, not past A.

tasks.name: Fearless Fishing
tasks.desc: Catch a fish at the Fishing Platform using either a net or rod.
tasks.notes:
Catch a fish at the Fishing Platform using either a net or rod.
Go to the Fishing Platform by talking with Jeb Wormwood (after The Slug Menace) or Holgart (before The Slug Menace and after Salt In The Wound). Use a fishing spot in the east with a fishing rod or a fishing net. Don't forget to bring bait when using a fishing rod (can be bought in Witchaven).

tasks.name: Water Logged
tasks.desc: Cross the River Dougne using the log balance.
tasks.notes: Cross the River Dougne using the log balance which is located west of the northern bank in East Ardougne. Falling off the log and into the water will also grant the achievement.

tasks.name: Green Fingers
tasks.desc: Pickpocket the master farmer north of Ardougne.
tasks.notes: Pickpocket a master farmer just north of East Ardougne. One can be found just west of the Manor Farm, walking around the two wheat fields.

tasks.name: A Natural Thief
tasks.desc: Attempt to steal a nature rune from a chest in a house to the east of Ardougne market.
tasks.notes: Attempt to steal a nature rune from a secure chest in the building east of the gem stall at the Ardougne market. Pick the lock on the door, go up the stairs, and pick the lock of one of the chests.

tasks.name: The Coal Train
tasks.desc: Mine some coal at the site between Witchaven and the Legends' Guild.
tasks.notes: Mine some coal at the Legends' Guild south-west mine between Witchaven and the Legends' Guild.

tasks.name: Are You Chicken?
tasks.desc: Kill a swordchick in the Tower of Life.
tasks.notes:
Kill a swordchick in the Tower of Life.
To make a swordchick, a raw chicken and a raw swordfish need to be used on the south-western altar in the basement of the Tower of Life.

If the previous tiers of the area tasks have also been completed: Talk to the Town crier, who is located at the Ardougne market, to claim the rewards for the medium achievement set:
Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.

tasks.name: Brace Yourself
tasks.desc: Recharge a combat bracelet or a skills necklace at the Legends' Guild.
other:
One of:
• 68 Magic Magic (b) (to cast Lvl-5 enchant) or
• 59 Thieving Thieving (to steal a tablet from the Chaos Druid Tower Dungeon.)

One of:
• 72 Crafting Crafting (b) (to craft a dragonstone necklace) or
• 72 Thieving Thieving (to steal one from the Ardougne Castle chests)
tasks.notes:
Recharge a combat bracelet or a skills necklace at the totem pole inside the Legends' Guild. A quick way to get to the Guild is by going to fairy ring BLR.
Attempting to recharge a fully charged combat bracelet or skills necklace will not grant the achievement.

tasks.name: Shadow Boxing
tasks.desc: Kill a shadow warrior in the Legends' Guild basement.
tasks.notes: Kill a shadow warrior in the Legends' Guild basement. The shadow warriors do not appear as yellow dots on the minimap.

tasks.name: Just Like That
tasks.desc: Enter the Magic Guild in Yanille.
tasks.notes: Enter the Wizards' Guild in Yanille. Boosts can be used to enter the guild.

tasks.name: Nice View
tasks.desc: Use the portal in the Magic Guild to teleport to Thormac's tower.
tasks.notes: Use the western portal located on the top floor of the Wizards' Guild to teleport to the Sorcerer's Tower.

tasks.name: You're the Dirty Rascal
tasks.desc: Be on the winning side in a game of Castle Wars.
tasks.notes:
Be on the winning side in a game of Castle Wars. A draw will not count. This achievement does not require everyone in the match to be present at the end. It can be completed by having four players join a match, having the player who needs the achievement score, and then the other three players can simply leave via the exit portals. The player wanting the achievement MUST stay until the end of the match, however.
It is possible to complete this achievement with only one other player by doing the following steps:
Afterwards, get 1 point and wait till you win. The other player can leave by waiting a few minutes where they spawned.
It is also possible to exit a match halfway through if your team is losing (and you know that the other team is going to win.) Then enter the winning teams portal to re-join the match on the winning side and get the achievement. Please note however that you can only re-join if someone else leaves the match from the team you are trying to join, so there is a chance that if you leave you might not be able to re-join.

subs.html: Go to the Castle Wars lobby with the other player.
One player must enter the Zamorak portal and the other player must enter the Saradomin portal.
Both players logout/go to lobby and re-enter the same world that you were in previously.
Enter the same portals again. A 3 minute countdown should appear if successful.

tasks.name: Ourania Mania
tasks.desc: Cast the Ourania Teleport spell.
tasks.notes: Cast the Ourania Teleport spell which requires 1 law, 6 earth, and 2 astral runes. The player must be on the Lunar spellbook and have talked to Baba Yaga after completing Lunar Diplomacy to learn the spell. Boosts may be used to reach the Magic skill requirement.

tasks.name: Not on My Watch
tasks.desc: Pickpocket a watchman in Yanille while wearing gloves of silence.
tasks.notes:
Successfully pickpocket a watchman on the 1st floor (UK) / 2nd floor (US) of the Watchtower north of Yanille while wearing the gloves of silence.
To get up to the 1st floor (UK) / 2nd floor (US) of the Watchtower, players can climb up the trellis on the northern wall of the tower.
Boosts may be used for the Thieving requirement.

tasks.name: It Just Croaked
tasks.desc: Kill a frogeel in the Tower of Life.
tasks.notes:
Kill a frogeel in the Tower of Life.
Use a raw cave eel and giant frog legs on the western altar (be careful not to eat the giant frog legs).

tasks.name: Get Your Stinking Hands Off Me
tasks.desc: Have a monkey minder put you in Ardougne Zoo's monkey cage.
tasks.notes: Wield the Karamjan monkey greegree while in the Ardougne Zoo and speak to one of the monkey minders to be put in the monkey cage.

tasks.name: Vine-detta
tasks.desc: Kill your own jade vine after the Back to my Roots quest.
tasks.notes:
Kill the player grown wild jade vine after the Back to my Roots quest.
Plant a jade vine seed and, optionally, pay Horacio 10 wildblood hops (8 with the master farmer outfit) to protect it. Return to the plant once it is fully grown, and check its health. Do not 'clear' the patch. Instead, the jade vine must be left alone after checking it, for about 3 hours more. After that, it turns wild and becomes a level 72 wild jade vine (which should look like this), which players can kill for 2,500 Slayer experience and 650 Woodcutting experience. Remember to take decent melee weapons (rune or above recommended).
Optionally, a Supreme growth potion (leafy) can be used to instantly grow the wild jade vine. You must still wait several hours for it to turn wild, however.

tasks.name: Living on a Prayer
tasks.desc: Use the Air Guitar emote near the musician outside the monastery south of Ardougne.
tasks.notes:
Use the Air Guitar emote near the musician south-east of the Ardougne Monastery, south of Ardougne.
Quick ways to unlock new music tracks to reach the requirement include exploration, quests, and Dungeoneering.

tasks.name: Who Wants to Watch the Watchtower?
tasks.desc: Cast the Watchtower Teleport spell.
tasks.notes: Cast the Watchtower Teleport spell which requires 2 law runes and 2 earth runes. Teleport tablets do not work.

tasks.name: Monkey Business
tasks.desc: Cross the monkey bars in the Yanille Agility Dungeon.
other: 57 Agility Agility (b) or
tasks.notes:
Cross the monkeybars from either side in the Yanille Agility dungeon.
The entrance north of Yanille requires a slash weapon to access, and it requires level 57 Agility to cross from northern side. The entrance in southern Yanille requires level 82 Thieving and a lockpick to access. Players do not need to be successful at crossing the monkey bars; a failed attempt will also complete the achievement.

tasks.name: It's My Newt
tasks.desc: Catch a red salamander from the Hunter area outside of Ourania Altar.
tasks.notes:
Catch a red salamander from the Hunter area outside of Ourania Runecrafting Altar.
Requires a small fishing net (tool belt does not work) and a rope to set up traps.
If As a First Resort is completed, players will be able to boost their Hunter skill by 7 levels by using the mud bath in Oo'glog.
It can be feasibly completed by boosting with at least 54 Hunter if the player has the Ourania Teleport spell. Having 54 Hunter allows the player sufficient time for a few attempts at the trap with the mud bath level boost before it decays under level 59. Simply Home Teleport teleport to Oo'glog lodestone and bathe in the mud bath. Step out of it and immediately cast the Ourania Teleport. Upon arrival, run to the young trees and set up a trap as quickly as possible. With a bit of luck, the challenge will be completed rather easily.

tasks.name: A Taste of the Exotic
tasks.desc: Pick a papaya or coconut from the fruit tree patch near Tree Gnome Village.
tasks.notes:
Pick a papaya or coconut from the fruit tree patch near Tree Gnome Village.
It takes about 16 hours for these trees to grow. It does not have to be a new tree.

tasks.name: Blood Bank Withdrawal
tasks.desc: Attempt to steal blood runes from the chest in the chaos druid tower's dungeon.
tasks.notes: Attempt to steal blood runes from any of the three chests in the Chaos Druid Tower's dungeon. The attempt does not need to be successful. Merely attempting to open the chest will complete the achievement.

tasks.name: Artillery Strike
tasks.desc: Use a catapult in Castle Wars after gaining the knowledge from the Catapult Construction quest.
tasks.notes:
Use a catapult in a Castle Wars game after gaining the knowledge from the Catapult Construction quest.
Just use a rock, found on a table on the ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US), with a catapult and shoot. Players do not need to hit anyone or anything. It is strongly recommended to do this when Castle Wars is the spotlighted minigame.

tasks.name: Catching Some Rays
tasks.desc: Non-ironman:Catch a manta ray in the Fishing Trawler activity.Ironman:Successfully cook a rocktail on the Witchaven dock.
tasks.notes:
For non-ironman:
Catch a raw manta ray in the Fishing Trawler minigame. To obtain the raw manta ray, check the trawler net on the docks west of the ship after completing a round. Fishing level boosts such as fishing potions (+3) and admiral pies (+5) may be used. Boosts can be used right before checking the trawler net as the required level does not have to be met during the activity itself. It is a common misconception that this requires finding a group, but the minigame can be played, and the achievement completed, all solo. Players simply need to complete one round of the minigame with a high Fishing level in order to obtain manta rays. Obtaining this fish is not a matter of luck; even catching one fish during the minigame will result in the fish being a manta ray provided players have the requisite Fishing level.
For ironmen:
Successfully cook a rocktail on the Witchaven dock. As there is no range in Witchaven to cook, players must light a fire near Col. O'Niall then cook the rocktail.

tasks.name: Abyssal Valet
tasks.desc: Have an abyssal titan familiar hold essence for you while runecrafting at Ourania Altar.
tasks.notes:
Runecraft at the Ourania Runecrafting Altar while having an abyssal titan familiar hold pure essence.
Essence held in runecrafting pouches will work. However, using a legendary pet with the "Beast of Burden" ability will not; the legendary pet must be dismissed and the Beast of Burden itself summoned using the pouch.

tasks.name: You Could Just Knock
tasks.desc: Attempt to picklock the door to the basement in Yanille Agility Dungeon.
tasks.notes: Pick the lock on the door to the basement of the Yanille Agility dungeon. A lockpick or hair clip is required to pick the door's lock. The door is near the dungeon's southern entrance, close to the Yanille bank. The door must be unlocked from the southern side, as it is not locked when entered from the north. Temporary skill boost can be used to meet the level 82 Thieving requirement. Despite the official description, the player must succeed in picking the lock to complete the achievement.

tasks.name: Honestly, It's Not a Purse
tasks.desc: Remove pure or impure essence from a giant pouch at Ourania Altar.
tasks.notes: Remove pure or impure essence from a giant pouch at the Ourania Runecrafting Altar. A giant pouch requires level 75 Runecrafting to use and can be bought from Wizard Korvak in the Runecrafting Guild for 50,000 coins or obtained as a drop from abyssal monsters. An expansive pouch will work. Pure essences must be manually removed from pouch for this achievement to count. Crafting essences directly on the altar will consume essences in all pouches but will not count for the achievement.

tasks.name: Almost Made in Ardougne
tasks.desc: Make a bane crossbow from scratch, performing each step within either Witchaven or Yanille. (X/7)
tasks.notes: Make a bane crossbow from scratch, performing each step within either Witchaven or Yanille. A main-hand bane crossbow is required; an off-hand or 2h crossbow will not grant the achievement. Players may obtain magic logs, raw meat, and a bane bar beforehand when completing this achievement. The only meat which will work is raw beef, raw wolf meat, raw bear meat, or raw yak meat.
